title: Stronger productive capacities mean stronger economies
discussion_signal: UNCTAD frames productive capacity as a composite of skills, energy, transport, digital access, and institutions, and presents measurement and requested support as routes to resilience. A reply reporting inaccessible material supplies a small but relevant access counter-signal: knowledge infrastructure itself can exclude intended users.
linked_research_question: How do skills, infrastructure, digital access, and institutions combine to shape development resilience and uneven participation in the global economy?
limits: Institutional summary and one visible reaction
